notes.title: Trading Cards Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello All!

Trading cards have been added to Vicky Saves the Big Dumb World! Play, collect, and craft badges.

Collect:

- 3 unique profile backgrounds
- 1 set of five trading cards to craft badges
- 5 emoticons 

Let's destroy some goofy demons!

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Pricing Change Update
notes.content:
Hello All!

I have lowered the price of Vicky Saves the Big Dumb World to celebrate over six months of being on Steam. A big thank you to all who have played my little game and a big thank you to all who will play in the future.

Happy Gaming!

-Kris

notes.title: First Update for Vicky Saves the Big Dumb World
notes.content: The first update for Vicky will be live Friday October 16th. This update will now allow users to toggle between fullscreen and windowed mode. The update will also allow users to take screenshots in game and share them with other users, this is a functionality I overlooked when the game was first released. A few minor bug fixes and collision checks will also be addressed. Happy gaming!
